Here's tonight's digest: 3 important unread emails. Northwind invoice #4471 is overdue, Alice Chen asked for the vendor breakdown, and your Denver flight on the 14th has a gate change.

notes: Reacting right after a trigger fires. The message names nothing; only the conversation (the agent's own message, tagged with its id) identifies the target. The log-hours reminder also fires in the evening, so 'these' must resolve to the agent whose message is on screen. A wrong create can't see the trigger (listTriggers is per agent) and the digests keep coming. Conversation mirrors the real log: the agent's report (agent_message, rendered today as '[SUCCESS] Nightly digest: ...', with the agent id added in the new modes), then Poke relaying it to the user (poke_reply). The user only ever sees the relay.
